provenance.quote: A self-propelled grass mower comprising:
a wheel motor, driving a wheel
a wheel motor, driving a wheel
a cutting blade motor, driving a cutting blade
a cutting blade motor, driving a cutting blade
a rechargeable battery, supplying power to the wheel motor and the cutting blade motor
a guidewire sensor, detecting a magnetic field generated by a current flowing in a guidewire which is formed in a loop shape

a control device, determining, based on an output of the guidewire sensor, whether the self-propelled grass mower is within or out of a region enclosed by the guidewire, and controlling autonomous traveling in a grass-mowing region
a main body chassis, holding the wheel motor and the cutting blade motor
a main body cover, covering the main body chassis
a plurality of front wheels are provided on a front side of the main body chassis
a plurality of rear wheels are provided on a rear side
the guidewire sensor has a coil for detecting a change in a magnetic field
the cutting blade motor is a brushless DC motor and is provided with an inverter circuit having a plurality of switching elements for driving the brushless DC motor
having a plurality of switching elements for driving the brushless DC motor
a guidance signal generator for causing a pulsed current group to flow at predetermined time intervals is connected to the guidewire
a guidewire sensor, detecting a magnetic field generated by a current flowing in a guidewire which is formed in a loop shape
